gizmo.title: Kiʻina hanana
gizmo.description: Hoʻokahi kiʻina o kekahi hanana lālā. E hoʻopili i kēlā me kēia koho i kekahi kiʻina ʻē aʻe me # a ukali ʻia e kona id kiʻina.

configure.title: Id kiʻina
configure.description: Ka mea e loulou ai nā koho: alakaʻi ka loulou i # a ukali ʻia e kēia id i kēia kiʻina. Nā hua palapala, nā helu a me nā kaha.

configure.title: Hopena
configure.description: Inā hoʻopau kēia kiʻina i kekahi ala, a pehea i hopena ai.

configure.title: Helu
configure.description: Ka helu no ka hiki ʻana i kēia hopena. ʻO ka helu hopena kiʻekiʻe loa ma ka hanana ka nui loa.
